function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the Ronin Bridge theft (March 2022) and the Harmony Horizon Bridge theft (June 2022) as a comparative evidence review. Return only evidence that can be cited by the exact source IDs you provide, and make every source ID explicit and stable. Prioritize official public attributions and primary/authoritative sources (for example, United States Treasury sanctions notices, Federal Bureau of Investigation statements, court filings, company incident reports, blockchain analytics reports, and reputable investigative reporting). For each incident separately, identify: (1) what is publicly attributed to Lazarus Group, APT38, North Korea, or other actors, and whether the wording is allegation, assessment, or documented fact; (2) known stolen-fund wallet addresses and transaction flows, including laundering routes, mixers, bridges, decentralized exchanges, and timing, but only where the source explicitly documents them; (3) wallet behavior or transaction-pattern evidence; (4) operational infrastructure, malware, social engineering, or other technical links, if documented; and (5) uncertainty, contradictions, competing attribution hypotheses, and alternative explanations. Then compare the incidents and identify only explicitly supported cross-incident links or similarities, distinguishing generic laundering similarities from wallet/address/transaction/infrastructure continuity. Do not infer a relationship merely from similar behavior, dates, actors, or labels. Do not invent facts, source IDs, entity IDs, relation names, or wallet addresses. Structure the response so every factual statement has one or more source IDs, and clearly label unsupported or unresolved questions."}
function.name: ConductResearch
